services.title: Residential Construction
services.shortDesc: Independent luxury villas, duplex homes, and multi-floor residential apartments built with reinforced structural strength.
services.fullDesc: From custom architectural planning to final turnkey finishing, BuildSphere designs and builds high-quality residential houses tailored to your family's lifestyle and budget, strictly adhering to Vasthu principles and IS building codes.
features: Turnkey Construction from Foundation to Handover

services.title: Commercial Construction
services.shortDesc: Modern commercial complexes, corporate offices, retail spaces, and showrooms engineered for maximum utility and aesthetics.
services.fullDesc: We construct modern commercial properties designed for business longevity. With BuildSphere's in-house structural engineering team, we ensure expansive column-free layouts, high-load capacities, fire safety norms, and rapid project delivery.

services.title: Architectural Design
services.shortDesc: Scientific space planning, contemporary 2D floor layouts, realistic 3D exterior elevations, and government sanction drawings.
services.fullDesc: Great structures start with visionary blueprints. Our architects craft functional, aesthetically striking plans customized for natural ventilation, sunlight, and spatial harmony, complete with realistic 3D renders before ground is broken.

services.title: Structural Design
services.shortDesc: Earthquake-resistant structural engineering, soil-specific foundation designs, beam-column detailing, and stability certificates.
services.fullDesc: Our in-house structural engineering team delivers mathematically sound, seismically resilient designs. Every footing, column, and slab is calculated with precision to withstand heavy loads and harsh environmental conditions.
features: Soil Bearing Capacity & Deep/Shallow Foundation Design
RCC Beam, Column & Slab Reinforcement Schedules

services.title: Interior Design
services.shortDesc: Bespoke residential and corporate interior solutions including modular kitchens, designer false ceilings, and ambient lighting.
services.fullDesc: Transform your bare walls into luxurious, ergonomic living environments. We blend premium materials, ambient lighting, custom carpentry, and Italian marble finishes to craft breathtaking living rooms, bedrooms, and office suites.
features: Custom Modular Kitchens with Premium Hardware
Designer False Ceilings with Warm Ambient Lighting
Full Wardrobes, Crockery Units & TV Wall Units

services.title: Building Renovation
services.shortDesc: Complete home transformation, structural retrofitting, modern facade facelifts, floor additions, and waterproofing solutions.
services.fullDesc: Breathe new life into aging buildings. Whether you need an exterior makeover, adding additional floors, structural strengthening, or solving persistent dampness with advanced waterproofing, BuildSphere delivers hassle-free renovation.

testimonials.name: K. Venkata Rao
testimonials.text: Building a home is once in a lifetime, and choosing BuildSphere was the best decision. Their milestone payment model gave us immense peace of mind. The structural engineering is solid and the finishing is top notch. Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: M. Prasad Reddy
testimonials.text: BuildSphere delivered our commercial complex 3 weeks ahead of schedule. Their transparency in material specifications—from Vizag Steel to UltraTech cement—was 100% genuine. The team handles government approvals and site supervision with complete professionalism.

testimonials.name: S. Anusha
testimonials.text: Their 3D elevation and interior design match the final constructed house down to the smallest millimeter! 20+ years of engineering experience shows in how effortlessly they manage labour, materials, and Vasthu requirements.
